svg.text: ada_ecu core — C++17, one process, three threads
Component architecture — two processes, three layers
Every component has one responsibility. The layer a component sits in fixes what it may touch.
controller — the clock, the threads, the sockets
business logic — pure functions of their inputs
R13 machine, one for both sources
the M1 NLOS plugin, bands and dwell
data — models and stores, holding no rules
No layer is collapsed: admission cannot reach a socket, a plugin cannot send a datagram, and the detector cannot reach the store.
Its only route in is one JSONL line through a parser.
Joined to the core only by argv,
exit codes and stdout. No FFI, no RPC.
seam — a provided interface meeting a required one
Four components the HLD names but its MVC table does not place: udp_socket, registry, the detector's frame_source and the detector's own config reader. They are drawn here as the
controller's socket holder, a lookup, and two seams — reported to architecture rather than assigned on a slide.
